title: Epidemiological Herd-Immunity Framing: Layer-Wise Coverage Needed to Steer Reliably

original_idea.body: Steer at increasing subsets of layers and find the coverage threshold for reliable suppression under perturbation. Inference-only sweep.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain: layer-coverage redundancy informs robust steering against evasion, but the link is one step broader (level 3).

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Layer-subset steering sweep + suppression measurement; clear methodology, novice+mentor feasible (level 4).

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused deliverable (coverage-threshold curve), subset sweeps add modest effort (level 4).

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent-friendly inference sweep on open models, robustness-relevant (level 4).

novelty.reasoning: Layer-coverage 'herd-immunity threshold' framing for steering robustness appears mostly novel.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Multi-layer coverage-threshold framing for robust steering appears underexplored.
